Taking the antiderivative and evaluating the difference at the bounds, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{1}^{16}\frac{1}{\sqrt[3]{{x}^{2}}}\,\text{d}x & ={\int }_{1}^{16}{x}^{-2/3}\,\text{d}x \\  & =\frac{{x}^{-2/3+1}}{(-\frac{2}{3}+1)}{|}_{1}^{16} \\  & =3\,{x}^{1/3}{|}_{1}^{16} \\  & =3\,\sqrt[3]{x}{|}_{1}^{16} \\  & =3(\sqrt[3]{16}-\sqrt[3]{1}) \\  & =3(2\sqrt[3]{2}-1).\end{aligned}
$$
